name: Dual Grid Traversal
definition: Traverses over cubes in a dual grid. A dual grid is formed by placing a vertex in the center of each cube in a primal grid, and connecting adjacent vertices into cubes. Each 2x2x2 cube in the dual grid spans a 3x3x3 region in the primal grid.
summary: Dual Grid Traversal creates a cell-centered grid by connecting primal cube centers to bridge cracks in adaptive mesh refinement data without re-sampling.
